content.text:
I submitted index 17 (In 0.415, Sb 0.585) as the best composition, with a measured EQE of 0.0248%. All three merit measurements are used up. I didn't use any of the XRD budget, so the phases in these films are unconfirmed.

| Index | Sb fraction | Why I picked it | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0.22 | Matches In₁₁Sb₃O₂₄, which is stable and has a predicted band gap of 1.9 eV | 0.0052 |
| 15 | 0.51 | Matches InSbO₄, which is stable and has a predicted band gap of 2.2 eV | 0.0174 |
| 17 | 0.585 | Continues the rising trend; also one of the Gaussian-process model's top 5 suggestions | **0.0248** |

EQE rose steadily with Sb content, and I never found the peak. The best composition could be at higher Sb (indices 18–27), which I didn't measure. My guess is that EQE drops there: the predicted band gap of In₃Sb₅O₁₂ (Sb 0.625) is 2.77 eV, just above the 2.7 eV light, so it would absorb poorly. That comes from the model only; I didn't test it.
